reason: A is the better, though still incomplete, proposal because its oxide dispersion provides a plausible combination of low-temperature strengthening and high-temperature tribofilm formation that can be directly tested against CoCrFeNi. B largely transplants a mechanism demonstrated with 25 at.% Ag in TiNbZr to only 2 at.% Ag in chemically different CoCrFeNi, while incorrectly implying Ag oxidation and offering no basis for forming a continuous Ag-containing layer across the full range.
